name: shoot.remove_crew
description: Takes a person off a shoot's crew, by id, so two people with one name stay apart.
sql:
with gone as (delete from brandbase.crew c where c.id = :crewId and c.shoot_id = :id returning c.id)
select brandbase.shoot_json(to_jsonb(s), coalesce((select jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(c)) from brandbase.crew c
  where c.shoot_id = s.id and c.id not in (select id from gone)), '[]')) as result
from brandbase.shoots s where s.id = :id and s.brand_id = :brand
